title: Altus Research: AMR Market Outlook 2023
text: Outlook edition published March 4, 2023. The warehouse AMR market will reach $9.8B by 2030 under the base case, a 11% CAGR from 2022. This edition predates the 2024-2025 fleet-software shift and has been superseded by newer outlooks.

facts.statement: The warehouse AMR market will reach $9.8B by 2030, a 11% CAGR from 2022.
